name: MSExchangeOnline_RemoveInboxRule
author: Fabien Bloume, StrangeBee
description: Removes a malicious Exchange Online inbox rule via Microsoft Graph. Reads the target mailbox UPN and Graph rule ID from a case custom field (name configurable, defaults to "inbox-rule-input"), formatted as "<mailboxUPN>|<ruleId>".

configurationItems.name: client_id
configurationItems.description: Client ID/Application ID of Microsoft Entra ID Registered App (requires MailboxSettings.ReadWrite and User.Read.All application permissions)

configurationItems.name: client_secret
configurationItems.description: Secret for Microsoft Entra ID Registered Application

configurationItems.name: custom_field_name
configurationItems.description: Name of the case custom field holding the target mailbox UPN and Graph rule ID, formatted as "<mailboxUPN>|<ruleId>"
